name: 120bpm_click_16ths_play_16ths
description: The control. Click and player agree, so 1.3 has nothing to do: no position is invented, the detection interval is the click's either way, and both modes must land in the same place. Its ceiling is deliberately 100 — this fixture is here to prove the change is inert when it should be, and it fails only if the score drops.
